svg.text: How long ago was the rating in the window actually given?
Median age of the current rating, one dot per local authority. The two schemes are drawn apart, never averaged.
Within FHRS alone — same scheme, same rules — the median runs 0.6 to 3.3 years. That is a 6× spread in how current a published rating is.
A rating is displayed in the window with no indication of its age.
Freshest and stalest, by scheme. Dot area is the number of establishments.
